schema_note: v2.8 accessibility design-compliance mapping responding to the inclusiveness review gap 'machine vision cannot certify accessibility'. Maps design elements to the five requirement areas of GB 55019-2021 at theme level, marking each mapping as design intent pending field audit. Machine-vision self-checks do not substitute for professional accessibility certification; field certification is carried by the P5 third-party accessibility audit.

standard.title_zh: 建筑与市政工程无障碍通用规范
standard.title_en: General code for accessibility of buildings and municipal engineering (translated title; Chinese original authoritative)
standard.issuer: 住房和城乡建设部（公告 2021年第174号）
standard.nature: 强制性工程建设规范（全文强制，共 108 条）
requirement_areas: 无障碍设施施工验收和维护

mappings.element_zh: 全域慢行无障碍通行带（组件库）
mappings.design_commitment_zh: 全线无高差通行，轮椅环通。
mappings.design_commitment_en: Step-free travel along the full line with wheelchair circulation.

mappings.element_zh: 六站厅无障碍出入口与电梯
mappings.element_en: Accessible entrances and lifts of the six halls

mappings.element_zh: 六站厅无障碍卫生间/厕位
mappings.element_en: Accessible toilets/compartments of the six halls
mappings.design_commitment_en: Reserved to the code's dimensional requirements.

mappings.element_zh: 轮椅坡道与缘石坡道（S2 站厅前区 kerbless 人字铺装）
mappings.element_en: Wheelchair ramps and kerb ramps (kerbless herringbone paving at the S2 hall forecourt)

mappings.element_zh: merge 地刻与 commit 广场铺装
mappings.element_en: Merge inlay and commit plaza paving
mappings.design_commitment_zh: 整体无高差，轮椅与视障友好。
mappings.design_commitment_en: Overall step-free surface, wheelchair- and vision-impaired-friendly.

mappings.design_commitment_zh: 大字、盲文、语音信息交流预留。
mappings.design_commitment_en: Large-print, braille and voice information-exchange provisions reserved.

mappings.element_zh: 非数字等价路径（人工问询、纸质导览，SEB ai_off_path）
mappings.element_en: Non-digital equivalent paths (staffed enquiry, print guides; SEB ai_off_path)
mappings.design_commitment_zh: 每个 AI 服务点强制等价路径。
mappings.design_commitment_en: A mandatory equivalent path at every AI service point.
mappings.requirement_area: 无障碍信息交流设施（服务等价延伸）

mappings.element_zh: 轨迹服务亭低位服务界面
mappings.element_en: Low-position service counter of the trace-service kiosk

mappings.design_commitment_zh: 按规范施工验收与维护要求组织验收。
mappings.design_commitment_en: Acceptance organised to the code's construction-acceptance and maintenance requirements.
mappings.requirement_area: 无障碍设施施工验收和维护

discipline.claim_scope_zh: 仅主张设计意图与规范要求领域一致，不主张任何现场认证结论。
discipline.claim_scope_en: Claims design-intent alignment with the code's requirement areas only; no field-certification conclusions are claimed.
discipline.mapping_granularity_zh: 按主题领域映射，不作条款号级转述，以避免转述误差。
discipline.mapping_granularity_en: Mapped at theme-area level without clause-number paraphrase to avoid paraphrase error.
discipline.certification_boundary_zh: 机器视觉自检不替代无障碍专业认证，现场认证由 P5 第三方无障碍专业审查承担。
discipline.certification_boundary_en: Machine-vision self-checks do not substitute for professional accessibility certification; field certification is carried by the P5 third-party accessibility audit.

boundary_zh: 映射为设计意图层主张：仅主张与 GB 55019-2021 要求领域的一致性（待现场认证），不主张任何现场认证结论；现场认证由 P5 第三方无障碍专业审查承担，机器视觉自检不替代无障碍专业认证。
boundary_en: The mapping is a design-intent claim: only alignment with the requirement areas of GB 55019-2021 is claimed (pending field audit), with no field-certification conclusions; field certification is carried by the P5 third-party accessibility audit, and machine-vision self-checks do not substitute for professional certification.
